summary.text: Quentin Chapman is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 88 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A U.S. Army veteran, he has worked as a general contractor and in retail sales.

paragraphs.text: Chapman served in the U.S. Army for 12 years.
His career experience includes working as a general contractor, in retail sales, and in theft and loss prevention at Roopers Beverage.
He assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Kathleen Shaw, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
